name: com.gamecore.gameplay.entities
description: Catalog row 1 of the gameplay plugin library (P1.1): authored entities. Authoring: AuthoredEntity (authoring id minted once, definition reference, variant, override set, region auto-detected), EntityDefinition, VariantDefinition and OverrideSet. Kernel half: the entities plugin manifest with the entity.alive/variant/scaleMilli/visible slots, the entity.spawn/despawn/setVariant routes and the EntitySpawned/EntityDespawned/EntityVariantChanged events, one spawn recipe per definition whose exact revision is the definition's content hash, and the DisableAutoCreation command system. Presentation: headless-safe PrefabViewBinder, AnimatorBinder, AudioSourceBinder hook and InteractionTargetBinder stub. Editor: the entity.* authoring operations and validators.
